stem: In what way is the presentation of information in the two selections “Life on Mars” and “Say Yes to Exploring Mars” DIFFERENT?
instruction: Use “Life on Mars” and “Say Yes to Exploring Mars” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: “Life on Mars” explains how pictures of Mars help scientists, but “Say Yes to Exploring Mars” does not explain how scientists use pictures.

options.label: B
options.text: “Life on Mars” focuses only on what experts already know about Mars, but “Say Yes to Exploring Mars” focuses on what remains to be discovered about Mars.

options.label: C
options.text: “Life on Mars” describes discoveries about Mars, but “Say Yes to Exploring Mars” describes considerations for going to Mars.

options.label: D
options.text: “Life on Mars” includes theories that have been proposed about Mars, but “Say Yes to Exploring Mars” does not provide any theories.
